title: chore(stories): add categories
body:
## Description

This adds sections in our Storybook following the same organization as the [documentation API ref](https://www.algolia.com/doc/api-reference/widgets/js/).

Note that this **updates the stories URLs** and therefore we need to update the documentation links for v4.

Let me know if you want to go that route so that I PR the doc repo.

## Preview

[See stories →](https://deploy-preview-4154--instantsearchjs.netlify.com/stories)

comments.body: @samouss Do you have an easy solution in mind? Storybook's documentation isn't clear about sorting categories of stories.
already upvoted this once apparently but: https://github.com/storybookjs/storybook/issues/548#issuecomment-417202498
Typing issues on Storybook's end... Let's wait for storybookjs/storybook#8233 to be fixed.
we can add `@types/webpack-env` as a dev dep, or skipLibCheck: true
Upgrading to Storybook 5.2.3 fixed the issue.
@Haroenv PR sent in algolia/doc#3807. I'm also updating the PR for the new `index` widget.
The order of the sections changed [in the doc](https://www.algolia.com/doc/api-reference/widgets/js/) in the meantime ahah. I'll reflect the order in this PR.
